🚨 NEW FROM COCA-COLA: *Nalgreen* — The First Soda That *Snacks Back* 🥬💥  

Tired of choosing between refreshment and nutrition? Meet **Nalgreen** — Coca-Cola’s bold, vibrant, and *deliciously unexpected* new sparkling beverage:  
✅ Made with real cold-pressed **kale & beetroot**  
✅ Zero added sugar • 100% caffeine-free • Naturally flavored  
✅ 1 full serving of leafy greens + ½ serving of vibrant root veggies — in one crisp, lightly effervescent sip  

Think: earthy-sweet beet notes, a bright herbal lift from kale, and that unmistakable Coca-Cola crispness — reimagined. Not “health soda.” *Healthy soda.* Designed for busy professionals who move fast, fuel smarter, and still crave that moment of pure refreshment.  

🌱 No compromise. No aftertaste. Just real ingredients, real flavor, and real energy — from greens, not grams.  

👉 Try Nalgreen this summer — launching in select markets starting June 10.  
📍 Find it at Whole Foods, Target, and Coca-Cola Freestyle® stations.  

#Nalgreen #CocaCola #HealthySoda #FuelYourDay  
🌿 Because your hustle deserves hydration that *does more.*  

*P.S. Yes, it’s green. And yes, it tastes amazing. (Spoiler: We added a hint of lemon & mint to balance the earthiness — you’re welcome.)*  

👇 Tag your wellness-warrior coworker who needs this in their 3 p.m. slump.  

*© 2024 The Coca-Cola Company. Nalgreen: A new kind of refreshment.*  

*Note: Nalgreen is not intended to treat, cure, or prevent any disease. It’s simply a better-for-you soda — made by the brand you know, for the life you live.*
